title: Live action
description: One attempt to run one action. Published to the status exchange on every transition, with the status string as the routing key.

action.description: Reference to the action to run, in pack.name form. The one field the requester must supply besides parameters.

status.description: Current status. Also the routing key this record is published under; five of these fourteen have a durable queue bound to them.

parameters.description: Input for the action, keyed by parameter name. The shape is declared by the action's own metadata, which ships in a pack.

result.description: Whatever the runner returned. Any JSON type, including a bare scalar.

context.description: Who asked and why — user, parent execution, originating rule. Open mapping in the source.

callback.description: Where an asynchronous runner reports back to. Filled by the runner, not by the requester.

runner-info.description: Which process picked the work up. Wire key: runner_info.

notify.description: Per-execution notification settings, read by the notifier when the record completes.
